atlas.rotation_convention: atlas = Rot(rotation_deg) applied after an optional top-bottom mirror (mirrored) of the render face, in image coordinates (x right, y down; positive = clockwise on screen); rotation_deg and mirrored in each face entry are source A's, both sources are listed in sources[]

size_assumption: 10.000 in across the flats (11.547 in point to point), as fixed by the brief; if the tile is really 10 in point to point every dimension scales by 0.866
suggested_revit_bump_amount_note: Revit editor scale (whole number, 100 x the stored float). Start value taken from the repo calibration for a full-range 16-bit dimensional map (about 2.6 mm full scale, 1.6 mm joint); this map is 2.2 mm full scale with a 1.6 mm joint. Not checked in Revit in this trial; the pattern relief is a smaller share of the grey range than the joint step, so raise it if the pattern reads soft.

area_over_length.note: area / length is below 8 px because the three bands overlap at each of the 112 vertices; the 0.5 % area shortfall against the exact-hexagon area is the atlas width 4489 px versus 4489.5 px

colour.joint_colour_note: darkest across-joint bin of the render (about 13 % darker than the face tone); the render joint is only about 1.5 px wide, so its colour is mixed with the face edge and is a lower bound of the true joint tone

mix.render_note: 39 whole hexagons; the partly visible hexagons at the image border are not counted

pattern_statistics_vs_random_permutation.note: peak_* = largest non-zero Fourier component of the torus indicator field of that type, divided by its expectation for a random placement (a period-2 column stripe scores 14 for the textured field); collinear_triples = three textured faces in a straight line at spacing 1 or 2; a value near the random median or below means no periodic structure

largest_matte_cluster.note: at 57 % matte on a hexagonal lattice (site percolation threshold 0.5) one connected matte field is the normal outcome

repetition.method: NCC = normalised cross-correlation of zero-mean discs (radius 300 atlas px); shift tolerance +-12 atlas px; Raw sweep 5 deg, Matte sweep 15 deg
interpretation: Bump: whole-face NCC over the 12 D6 elements (mirror x 0/60/.../300 deg, 5 deg-sweep free rotation reported separately) is at the noise floor; the 20/40 deg null transforms and the D6 elements give the same patch-search maximum, so the bump shows no reuse beyond what a random 256 px window search finds by chance.

Colour: the layout keeps repeated use of one render face at rotations at least 17 deg away from any D6 element, so the D6 tests are clean, but the 20/40 deg patch search finds a colour window pair with NCC 0.81: Raw faces are built from 8 source faces (11 Raw faces, each a blend of two), so partial colour reuse at other angles is measurable. It is faint, low contrast albedo mottling and was not recognisable in the side-by-side review.
Whole-face colour NCC medians of 0.24 (Raw) and 0.15 (Matte) come from low-frequency cloudiness shared by all faces, not from repeated patches.

sample_size.note: Fixed by the brief. Revit's Texture Editor rounds Sample Size to the project's length unit, so in a 1/4 in project these values are not stored exactly; an exact quarter-inch alternative is 70.25 x 71.0 in (stretch +0.15 % / +0.18 %), not applied.
